rejects.event: Lakeland Queen was launched as a paddle steamer built by Lakeland Steel Products.
rejects.quote: Lakeland Queen was launched on 26 October 1986, and is the only sternwheeler passenger vessel in New Zealand.
rejects.why: The source quote confirms the year 1986 and the launch, but does not mention that it was built by Lakeland Steel Products.

rejects.event: Passenger train services running from Auckland to Rotorua were permanently stopped.
rejects.quote: However, owing to poor advertising of the service and the location of the station being a 15-minute walk from the town centre in an industrial area, passenger services stopped in October 2001.
rejects.why: The source quote mentions passenger services stopping in October 2001, but does not state the route was from Auckland to Rotorua or that the stoppage was permanent.
